name: 文字で記録
oneline: 食事・睡眠・体重・歩数・筋トレを文字で送ると、写真と同じように Desk の体の画面に入る
usage: Telegram で「体重65.2」「昼 カレー大盛り」「ベンチ60kg 10回3セット」のように送る
確実に記録したいときは「食事：」「筋トレ：」「記録：」を先頭に付ける
料理を文字で書いた分は推定として記録する。読めない値は Desk の要確認に出る
記録ではないと判断した文は、これまでどおり他のツールに渡す
howToCheck: 返事が来て、Desk の体の画面に値が出ることを見る

_en.name: Log by text
_en.oneline: Send meals, sleep, weight, steps or workouts as text, and they go into the Desk body screen just like photos
usage: On Telegram, send something like "weight 65.2", "lunch curry, large", or "bench 60kg 10x3"
To be sure it is logged, start with "meal:", "workout:" or "record:"
Meals described in text are logged as estimates. Values it cannot read show under Needs review in the Desk
Lines it decides are not records are passed on to the other tools, as before
howToCheck: Check that a reply comes and the value shows on the Desk body screen
